methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: The proposed system is based on a prototype software tool for the simulation and optimization of energy consumption in the building sector

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Presents a building-automation software tool with real-time energy monitoring and a rule-based A/C peak-load control algorithm; no EnPI/EnB measurement model is constructed or characterised (no normalisation variables, functional form, or estimation approach), so it falls under the v2.3 tool/software-without-measurement-model exclusion.

paper_type.evidence_quote: We developed an interactive software for building automation systems.

stage1.notes: Tool/software-design paper: interactive building-automation software applied to a supermarket (tertiary sector) for A/C peak-load shaving via zone-threshold control algorithms and real-time metering. No EnPI/EnB normalisation or baseline model is built. Ineligible under v2.3 tool-without-measurement-model clause; sector is tertiary/buildings so out of Corpus B independently. Eligibility is the main judgment call (energy monitoring + savings quantification could tempt an eligible read).
